<script setup lang="ts">
import { QBreadcrumbs, QBreadcrumbsEl } from 'quasar'
import Icon from './Icon.vue'

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  label: string
  href?: string
  disable?: boolean
  icon?: string
}

defineProps<{
  items: BreadcrumbItem[]
  separator?: string
}>()

defineEmits<{
  'item-click': [item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number]
}>()
</script>

<template>
  <q-breadcrumbs
    class="ds-breadcrumbs"
    separator=""
    role="navigation"
    aria-label="Breadcrumb"
  >
    <template #separator>
      <Icon 
        name="chevron_right" 
        size="sm" 
        color="primary"
        class="ds-breadcrumbs__separator-icon"
      />
    </template>
    <q-breadcrumbs-el
      v-for="(item, index) in items"
      :key="index"
      :label="item.label"
      :icon="item.icon"
      :to="item.href"
      :disable="item.disable"
      class="ds-breadcrumb"
      :aria-current="index === items.length - 1 ? 'page' : undefined"
      :aria-disabled="item.disable ? 'true' : undefined"
      @click="$emit('item-click', item, index)"
    >
      <template #default>
        <slot
          name="item"
          :item="item"
          :index="index"
          :is-last="index === items.length - 1"
        >
          {{ item.label }}
        </slot>
      </template>
    </q-breadcrumbs-el>
  </q-breadcrumbs>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
/**
 * SPARKLINE - OPTIMIZED
 * 
 * ✅ Optimized: cached min/max computation
 * ✅ No repeated Math.min/max calls
 */

import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { SparklineProperties } from './types'

const props = defineProps<SparklineProperties>()

// ✅ Cache min/max (computed once, not per point)
const min = computed(() => Math.min(...props.values))
const max = computed(() => Math.max(...props.values))
const range = computed(() => max.value - min.value || 1)

const points = computed(() => {
  if (props.values.length === 0) return ''
  
  return props.values
    .map((v, i) => {
      const x = (i / (props.values.length - 1)) * 100
      const y = 24 - ((v - min.value) / range.value) * 20
      return `${x},${y}`
    })
    .join(' ')
})

const variantClass = computed(() => {
  const variant = props.variant ?? 'positive'
  return `ds-sparkline--${variant}`
})
</script>

<template>
  <svg 
    viewBox="0 0 100 24" 
    class="ds-sparkline"
    :class="variantClass"
  >
    <!-- Filled area -->
    <polygon
      v-if="showArea"
      :points="`0,24 ${points} 100,24`"
      class="ds-sparkline__area"
    />
    
    <!-- Line -->
    <polyline
      :points="points"
      class="ds-sparkline__line"
      fill="none"
      stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
    />
    
    <!-- Dots -->
    <template v-if="showDots">
      <circle
        v-for="(value, i) in values"
        :key="i"
        :cx="(i / (values.length - 1)) * 100"
        :cy="24 - ((value - min) / range) * 20"
        r="2"
        class="ds-sparkline__dot"
      />
    </template>
  </svg>
</template>

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# MESX System Design Library

Shared design tokens, components, and styles for MES X.0 projects.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Run dev playground
npm run dev

# Build the library
npm run build
```

## Project Structure

```
src/
  tokens/       – Design tokens (colors, spacing, font sizes, radii)
  styles/       – Global CSS variables, Quasar SASS overrides
  components/   – Vue 3 design-system components
  index.ts      – Library entry point (barrel export)
  main.ts       – Dev playground entry
  App.vue       – Dev playground app
```

## Usage

```ts
// Import the library in a consumer project
import { MdsButton, colors, spacing } from '@mesx/system-design-lib';
import '@mesx/system-design-lib/style.css';
```

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

parameters:
- name: force_publish
  displayName: 'Force publish of the npm package when branch is not "main"'
  type: boolean
  default: false

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

jobs:
- template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
  parameters:
    folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
    auditLevel: 'critical'
- job: 'publish_npm_package'
  displayName: 'Build & Publish'
  pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
  steps:
  - task: npmAuthenticate@0
    inputs:
      workingFile: .npmrc
    displayName: Authenticate Private npm Registry

  - script: |
      npm install -D
    displayName: Install npm Dependencies

  - script: |
      npm run build
    displayName: Build Library

  - script: |
      npm publish
    displayName: Publish npm Package
    condition: ${{ or(eq(parameters.force_publish, true), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')) }}
